title: Sample word counter CLI
summary: Synthetic practice project: a command line tool `wc-lite <file>` that prints the number of lines, words and characters in a text file.

acceptanceChecks.text: Running `wc-lite sample.txt` on a file containing the two lines `hello world` and `foo` prints `lines: 2`, `words: 3` and `chars: 15`.
Running `wc-lite` on an empty file prints `lines: 0`, `words: 0` and `chars: 0`.
Running `wc-lite missing.txt` for a file that does not exist prints an error message and exits with a non-zero status.
